parameters.content:
## TBW v3.3 — Event-driven WhatsApp (NO 1-MINUTE CRON)
Replies require explicit dashboard authorization. A blocked reply produces a diagnostic node with a reason.
Once Meta confirms an automated reply, an authenticated internal timer event schedules ONE 3-min follow-up and a separate silent close at 20 min.
DNS-only retries are event-driven and recheck takeover. Nothing runs during idle periods.
Customer data/Sheets/Calendar/Meta credentials preserved. Import as NEW inactive workflow. Never publish alongside an existing WhatsApp listener.

parameters.jsCode: const old=$('05 - Translations').first().json;const r=$input.first().json;return [{json:{...old,ownerAlertError:r.error?(r.error.message||String(r.error)):''}}];

return [{json:{event_type:'workflow_error',workflow_id:'',workflow_name:'TBW FRESH - WhatsApp Router',execution_id:'',error_node:'07 - Send Owner Alert',error_message:String($json.ownerAlertError).slice(0,1000),observed_at:new Date().toISOString()}}];

const a=$input.first().json,s=a.s;return [{json:{receivedAt:new Date().toLocaleString('en-IN',{timeZone:'Asia/Kolkata'}),phone:a.phone,name:s.name,business:s.business,purpose:s.purpose,language:s.lang,source:'WhatsApp'}}];

parameters.jsCode: const e=$input.first().json;const ex=e.execution||{},er=ex.error||e.trigger?.error||{};return [{json:{event_type:'workflow_error',workflow_id:String(e.workflow?.id||''),workflow_name:String(e.workflow?.name||''),execution_id:String(ex.id||''),error_node:String(ex.lastNodeExecuted||er.node?.name||''),error_message:String(er.message||e.message||'Unknown n8n error').slice(0,1000),observed_at:new Date().toISOString()}}];
